spanish: Estas familias del reubenita; y fueron sus contados tres y cuarenta mil y siete cientos y treinta.

findings.issue: Gentilic Hebraizes the locked name Rubén as reubenita; the conventional Spanish gentilic is rubenita.

notes: Demonstrative, construct families, wayyiqtol, passive participle with 3mp suffix, and 43,730 in Hebrew order are licensed.
